run_mcts_search: run the MCTS search loop over the supernet to find optimal NASNet architectures
create_trainer: create a Trainer with batch_size and init_channels to load and evaluate a supernet model
define_search_space: define the NAS search space with constraints and an initial random point
collect_samples: collect architecture accuracy samples into the MCTS agent for training the prediction tree
load_mcts_agent: load a pickled MCTS agent from disk and resume the architecture search loop
